docs.title: go-lemmy
docs.text:
Pure-Go read client for the Lemmy REST API.

A pure-Go (CGO=0), dependency-free read client for the Lemmy REST API (/api/v3). Point it at any Lemmy instance and read its communities and posts. An optional Login stores a JWT for authenticated reads. Standard library only; builds for all 64-bit targets.

docs.title: At a glance
docs.text:
• CGO-free (CGO_ENABLED=0), Go 1.26+ — builds for every 64-bit target.
  • Zero third-party dependencies — standard library only.
  • Read-only — this is a read client; it does not post or mutate.
  • BSD-3-Clause.

See Usage for a runnable example and API reference for the full surface. The canonical, always-current reference is pkg.go.dev.

docs.title: API reference
docs.text: Source-verified against go-lemmy/lemmy. The authoritative, versioned reference is pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-lemmy/lemmy.

docs.text: Symbol Purpose New(instance string, ...Option) *Client Construct a client for a Lemmy instance URL. (*Client).Posts(ctx, PostsOptions) (*PostList, error) List posts for a community / sort / page. (*Client).Login(ctx, usernameOrEmail, password) error Store a JWT for authenticated reads.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"

    "github.com/go-lemmy/lemmy"
)

func main() {
    c := lemmy.New("https://lemmy.world")

    list, err := c.Posts(context.Background(), lemmy.PostsOptions{
        Community: "technology", Sort: "Hot", Limit: 20,
    })
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    for _, p := range list.Posts {
        fmt.Printf("%s — %s (score %d)\n", p.Title, p.Community, p.Score)
    }
}

New takes the instance base URL. PostsOptions selects the community, sort and page size. For authenticated reads, call Login first to store a JWT on the client.

For the complete, always-current API — every type and field — see pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-lemmy/lemmy.
